text_description: A dark, tailored skirt suit look centered on a fitted black tweed-style jacket worn over a plain black underlayer, paired with a matching high-waisted pencil skirt. The jacket has a collarless round neckline edged with textured/frayed trim, strong narrow shoulders, long straight sleeves, and a close-cut waist that opens slightly at the lower front to reveal the black layer beneath.
